==Hero Usage==
* Heroes ''will'' use this skill on recharge, completely ignoring its disabling effect. Occasionally heroes will postpone this skill if the target has recently activated a skill (as long as it remains visible in the skill activation window of the target).

== Notes ==
* Combined with a +33% [[attack speed]] boost as well as an [[adrenaline]] boost, this skill alone can interrupt foes more frequently than almost any other skill; only [[Psychic Distraction]] is an exception.
